title: Internal: Early Closure Fees on Accounts Opened With a Bonus
content:
## Accounts That Received a New-Account Bonus

- Early closure fee waivers do not apply to checking accounts that received a new-account bonus deposit. On these accounts the early closure fee recovers part of the bonus when the account is closed early.
- Check the account's transactions with get_bank_account_transactions_9173 for a bonus deposit (the description includes "NEW ACCOUNT BONUS").
- If a bonus deposit is present, close the account without waiving the fee (waive_early_closure_fee: false), provided the balance covers the fee.
